title: Canonical Local NAP v1.0
description: Canonical NAP (Name / Address / Phone) document for local-SEO projects — the SINGLE source of truth at projects/{slug}/local/nap.json (rules/local-seo-discipline.md R-144). Every skill/report that prints or compares NAP reads this doc; mismatches observed anywhere (GBP listing, site footer, LocalBusiness JSON-LD) are HIGH findings against it (consumed by scripts/discovery/gbp_audit_transform via scripts/discovery/nap_consistency). GAP-A2 (2026-06-10 acquisition spec, unified dispatch batch GAP-A-B2). STANDALONE by design: folding NAP into project.config.json would force the v1.5->v1.6 const bump + migration_0006 + migration of every live workspace config — this schema is the explicit fold-in candidate at the next scheduled project-config const bump. Multi-location businesses (multi-branch local-service portfolios) are first-class via locations[].

e164Phone.description: Strict E.164 (e.g. +902121234567). Looser observed surface forms ('0 (212) 123 45 67') are normalized at COMPARE time by scripts/discovery/nap_consistency.normalize_phone — never stored here.

street.description: Street line incl. building number (e.g. 'Atatürk Caddesi Numara 5'). Abbreviated surface forms (Cad./No:) are equated at compare time by nap_consistency.normalize_address_tokens.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (TR, CA, NG, ...). Aligns with project.config market; also drives the phone-normalization country default at compare time.

schema_version.description: Contract version of THIS document (rules/schema-versioning-discipline.md strict const).

business_name.description: Exact public business name as it must appear on GBP, site footer and LocalBusiness JSON-LD. Also the gbp-audit Step 4 query seed (replaces the phantom project.config brand_identity.business_name contract removed in gbp-audit v1.1).

locations.description: Branches/units for multi-location businesses. A location entry may override phone/address; omitted fields fall back to the top-level NAP at compare time (nap_consistency.compare_nap resolves by location_id).

location_id.description: Stable kebab-case slug for the branch (used as the compare_nap join key).

gbp_place_id.description: Google Business Profile place id for the branch, when known.

source_pages.description: URIs that PRINT the NAP (contact page, footer template page) — the audit surfaces a future site-side NAP check would crawl.
